description:
Use one editor control by its tree path (press, toggle, focus, select a tab, type text, set a value) or dismiss a dialog; the control's state is read back. Only when no named action fits.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/ui-activate"}

action.description: Default 'press'. press = synthetic left click on a button / ItemList item / PopupMenu item (index); toggle = flip a toggle-mode button; focus = grab_focus on any control; select_tab =…

button.description: dismiss_dialog only. 'cancel' (default — the safe close: cancel button / hide / OS close request), 'ok', or the exact text of a button in the dialog's row.

index.description: select_tab: tab index; press on an ItemList / PopupMenu: item index.

path.description: A control `path` from summer_ui_tree (required for every action except dismiss_dialog, which may use title instead), or 'main_screen' with action:'select_tab'.

submit.description: set_text on a LineEdit only: also emit text_submitted (the Enter key), e.g. to run a search box.

title.description: dismiss_dialog only: a visible window title (case-insensitive; exact wins, one substring match accepted, otherwise ambiguous_dialog) — from summer_ui_tree root:'dialogs'.

value.description: select_tab: tab title (or the main-screen editor name: '2D', '3D', 'Script', 'Game', 'AssetLib'); set_text: the text; set_value: the number.

name: summer_ui_activate
title: Use an editor control
